capability.unsupported_or_missing: keep APNs rollout disabled; never silently send environment to token-only v1

lease.semantics: server derives owner from bearer; atomically supersedes earlier installation lease, invalidates old registrations and rejects their later writes; installation UUID alone never authorizes reassignment

register.semantics: atomic per-lease monotonically increasing mutation; duplicate same sequence and same body is idempotent, same sequence with different body conflicts; rotated token replaces previous token of this lease

unregister.semantics: persists sequence tombstone, so delayed registration cannot resurrect the token; idempotent on an already absent registration

logout_order: stop accepting new registration work for old authenticated generation
cancel and await in-flight work in serialized account transport
send unregister tombstone while old bearer is usable
logout or revoke bearer server-side with transactional APNs lease revocation
clear local auth and pending retries; no old-generation retry may register under a new bearer
logout_offline: server logout/session revocation must revoke associated push lease; if unreachable, local logout cannot claim immediate remote unregistration; suppress old account UI and never retry old registration after logout
account_switch: new account obtains new server lease before registration; old lease writes cannot win later; client-local accountGeneration/request values are not server anti-replay credentials

errors.401:AUTH_SESSION_INVALID: no registration retry until authenticated restoration
errors.403:DEVICE_REGISTER_SCOPE_REQUIRED: refresh bearer once then await next valid scope
errors.409:APNS_LEASE_STALE: discard old generation; new authenticated generation may acquire lease
errors.409:APNS_MUTATION_STALE: discard superseded operation, never increment and replay old intent
errors.409:APNS_SEQUENCE_CONFLICT: protocol failure; do not retry changed body with same sequence
errors.422:APNS_TOKEN_INVALID: request new OS registration; no disk-token replay
errors.429:RATE_LIMITED: respect Retry-After with bounded jitter and current-generation check
errors.5xx:SERVER_UNAVAILABLE: bounded backoff only while lease/account/token generation is current

delivery.trust: payload text and URLs are not inbox content; fetch message with current auth; malformed/missing message_id opens inbox; wrong owner drops; stale fetch responses drop
delivery.dedupe: delivery and tap are separately deduplicated; backend retains stable delivery id across retries

provider.invalid_token: retire only exact environment/topic/token registration; handle APNs invalidation timestamp against registration time
provider.payload_types: alert and background use correct apns-push-type, priority, topic and expiration; background delivery is not guaranteed

compatibility.v1: existing /api/v1/devices/register and token-only unregister remain for current clients; do not reinterpret desktop-macos as APNs or change Android FCM
compatibility.v2: explicitly negotiated; platform macos plus APNs channel is distinct from v1 desktop-macos self-hosted registration
compatibility.agent_retirement: requires equivalent real signed-package foreground/background/terminated delivery, cold tap, rotation, logout and account-switch acceptance on each Apple platform

activation_blockers: Backend must define and verify installation ownership proof for replacement leases; installation UUID plus an unrelated bearer is insufficient.
Native lifecycle, authenticated registration transport, logout synchronization and real signed-package delivery are not integrated or accepted yet.
